scope: Publish exact source/results bytes with bounded, reconstructible byte chunks.

summary.scope: Publish closed contact-history, marking-domain or observable-method evidence with explicit scope.

manufactured_observable_qualification.scope: Qualify nested P2 transfer, exact affine-tensor volume norms and the Galerkin energy identity.
manufactured_observable_qualification.limitations: This is a numerical manufactured control on a unit cube with identical discrete point-quadrature loads, not a finite-footprint physical convergence case. Analytic tensor-volume integration, all quadratic nodal-transfer polynomials and a nonzero nested Galerkin energy defect are checked independently. Original body/contact/geometry/history/model accuracy and warmed native cost remain separate requirements.

original_initialization_coordinates_and_.scope: Recover the actual temporary body initialization coordinates from saved U coordinate maps.
original_initialization_coordinates_and_.limitations: The six omitted independent body entries define the held numerical rigid-coordinate origin in initialization; the complete original coordinate map restores six free body modes after release. This audit reports actual geometric coordinate/component identities. Different initialization constraints do not by themselves measure their effect on final friction history or stress, and matching coordinates do not establish physical convergence. The distinction remains explicit when interpreting coupled body/geometry refinements.
